name: Paracuellos de la Ribera (Spain)
description: Blue hoist third bearing two yellow crossed lances with a cross and an ear of wheat, the fly divided diagonally red above and yellow below.
history: Municipal flag of Paracuellos de la Ribera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two crossed lances with a cross and an ear of wheat on the blue hoist
